The '''coronation of Padmé Amidala''' was the ceremony in which [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Naberrie]], the young [[Princess of Theed]], was formally [[Crown/Legends|crowned]] and invested as [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] under the regnal name of Amidala. It occurred the morning after the abdication of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], in the presence of important Nabooian [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] like [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Background==
Unknown to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Naberrie]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], secretly the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, had covertly engineered her ascension to the throne, by suggesting to her parents that she should bid for the throne of Naboo.<ref name="SW:DP" /> Naberrie, who [[Prime Councilor]] [[Kun Lago]] believed was behind the publicization of a [[Foreign Affairs scandal]], quickly gained public support to become the next monarch. After the unpopular king's abdication, Naberrie was quickly prepared for her coronation.<ref name="ASD" />

==History==
{{Quote|When I got to Amidala's quarters they were already fitting her with a coronation gown. Governor Bibble was talking about her acceptance speech. The throne wasn't even up for grabs yet and everyone knew how it was going to turn out.|[[Ian Lago]]|<ref name="ASD" />}}
[[File:Wearing_the_coronation_gown.png|thumb|left|Amidala being fitted with her coronation gown]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]] living on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], abdicated the throne. The thirteen-year-old [[Princess of Theed]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Naberrie]], who went by the name of state of Amidala, was chosen to succeed him. As the former monarch's resignation had been known [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before the official announcement, Naberrie's coronation was properly prepared in advance. [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of the planet and Head of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]], had supervised the grooming of the Princess of Theed by a team of royal [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]]. While the palatial staff was in the middle of preparations for the upcoming event, Amidala' young boyfriend [[Ian Lago]] turned up and declared his love for the Princess. Amidala, however, informed him that their relationship had to end so she could devote her life to the people of Naboo.<ref name="ASD" />

The [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the ceremony, Amidala sat in the throne room of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] with her back to the wide [[Window/Legends|window]].<ref name="SWGS5" /> She [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends|wore]] a wide-shouldered, bright-[[Color/Legends|red]] robe adorned with [[Gold/Legends|gold]] embroideries, a hem of [[Potolli/Legends|potolli]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and a series of illuminated [[Sein jewel/Legends|sein jewels]].<ref name="ASD" /> She also bore the traditional make-up of the Naboo queens: a white facepaint, the red [[Scar of remembrance/Legends|scar of remembrance]] and two stylized beauty marks. One of the handmaidens then placed the [[Crown/Legends|crown]]&mdash;in fact an elaborate [[Wig/Legends|wig]] adorned with a [[Gold/Legends|gold]] faceframe and the precious [[Jewel of Zenda/Legends|Jewel of Zenda]]&mdash;on the seated Amidala's head.<ref name="SWGS5" /> The new Queen then delivered an official acceptance speech she had been writing the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] before, with the help of her chief advisor Bibble.<ref name="ASD" /> Upon her coronation, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] explained to her the old strategy of using decoys as a measure of safety.<ref name="dict">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> It was in this context that Queen Amidala first met [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who represented Naboo and the thirty-five other affiliated worlds of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]].<ref name="TPMIG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Amidala_coronation_sketch.png|thumb|100px|Sketch of Amidala's coronation by Randy Martinez]]
{{Quote|I wanted to capture the moment just before the crown is placed upon her head. Can she sense the tragedy that lies before her? Is she ready for such a task to lead Naboo?|Randy Martinez|<ref name="SWGS5" />}}
Amidala's coronation was first mentioned in [[2000]] in "[[A Summer's Dream]]," a short comic published the [[Star Wars Tales 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' series of comics. However, the only depiction of the ceremony was drawn by ''Star Wars'' illustrator [[Randy Martinez]] for the [[2010]] [[Topps]] trading card set ''[[2010 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 5]]''. Admittedly, Martinez had been wishing to create that scene for years, after visiting [[Caserta Palace]], [[Wikipedia:Italy|Italy]]&mdash;used in filming the interior scenes in the Naboo Royal Palace for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]&mdash;in [[2005]].<ref name="SWGS5" /> Palpatine and Plagueis' involvement in having Amidala crowned was also revealed in the novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="SW:DP" />

There are several key differences between Martinez' preliminary sketch and the trading card. While Amidala and her handmaidens were alone in the sketch, Palpatine and Sio Bibble were added in the background of the finalized product. Additionally, the dress worn by Amidala in the sketch was not the same as her "Throne Room Robe" shown in ''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'', and the crown was put on her head piece by piece.<ref name="SWGS5" />
